intent.en: Per Chief's 2026-11-11 12:00 card B and Arch's scope/acceptance notes, land the Arch-final W0-W9 execution plan (target work material, not evidence) as docs/development-evidence/plan/W0-W9.md: snapshot-disclaimer header with landing date, wave table, pending-user-decision section (U8/U7, ABI, eol, equivalence/release - listed without conclusions), hard constraints, and references (W0 closeout/QA review, P10, diag8, guards hashes). Docs only, zero GPU/windows; write scope is docs/development-evidence/plan/** plus .normify/**; no src/tests/fixtures/scripts/guards changes; no decision preemption.

acceptance: 文件 `docs/development-evidence/plan/W0-W9.md` 存在；UTF-8 / LF / 无 BOM；头部含「文档化快照；裁决项未定，不构成结论」+ 落仓时点 2026-11-11 + 可能过期/更新规则。
结构齐备：①头部声明 ②W0–W9 波次表（条目/依赖/片数/窗数/签名或裁决/完成判据）③待用户裁决区（U8/U7、ABI、eol、等价/发布四项齐全，措辞为「待用户裁决/待校准」且无结论）④硬约束（GPU 单窗互斥 + monitor 60/60、写锁单写者、高峰只读、采集脚本抽模块排 G-L2 之后等）⑤引用（W0 收口/QA 复核卡与哈希、P10、diag8、guards 哈希）。
全文不出现「已裁决」「已签」「已批」「等价通过」「发布通过」等结论性表述；「通过」仅限 W0 收口 A/B/C 在 attempt4 canonical 通过这一事实陈述并附卡/哈希。
写域：`git diff --name-only` 仅 `docs/development-evidence/plan/**` + `.normify/**`；`src/`、`tests/`、`fixtures/`、`scripts/`、guards/冻结产物零改动。
证据：`docs/development-evidence/plan/W0-W9.receipt.json`（task_id/verdict/内容源哈希/边界）+ `W0-W9.manifest.txt`（sha256+bytes，自核、不列自身）与 W0-W9.md 一并落仓；四门禁 + `normify check`；中文提交。
零 GPU、零窗口、不改判据/参考/容差/相机/recipe；不宣称上游等价/对外发布/双平台。
note: Chief 2026-11-11 12:00 派工卡 B（内容 owner Arch；落仓 Backend）。无硬依赖；纯文档、零窗、零 GPU。13:40 前停干净点。
